macros.name: maybebm
macros.doc: The \maybebm and \maybeit macros can be used in math expressions to make the arguments typeset as bold or italic respectively if the surrounding context is appropriate.

macros.name: maybebmsf
macros.doc: A convenience macro, \maybebmsf is available for handling boldness and sans-serif issues at the same time, as these are probably the most frequent problematic environments.

macros.name: maybeit
macros.doc: The \maybebm and \maybeit macros can be used in math expressions to make the arguments typeset as bold or italic respectively if the surrounding context is appropriate.

macros.name: maybeitsubscript
macros.doc: \maybeitsubscript is provided to shift subscripts to the left if the expression is italicised.

macros.name: maybesf
macros.doc: \maybesf makes the argument typeset with \mathsf{} if the surrounding text context is sans-serif.
